title: What The Flamenco Guitar Knows (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal Spanish philosophy absurdist
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The flamenco guitar does not ask permission to begin
It arrives like an argument and takes you from within
The rasgueado is a strum technique involving all five fingers
And watching it done properly is something that still lingers

[Pre-Chorus]
I tried to play flamenco once — the guitar looked confused
Like a concert piano being asked to make excuses

[Chorus]
What does the flamenco guitar know that I don't know?
It knows the weight of Andalusia in every note below
What does the flamenco guitar know in the heat of night?
It knows that passion played correctly puts the audience in flight
That's my boy

[Verse 2]
The cante is the voice, the baile is the dance
The toque is the guitar and they all take the same chance
Three disciplines arrive together like a single fact
The flamenco guitar is there to hold the whole intact

[Bridge]
Duende is the Spanish word for that thing you can't explain
The moment music makes the hair stand on the back of your brain
No science has explained it and no lecture can contain it
The flamenco guitar produces it and doesn't need to name it

[Outro]
Flamenco guitar knows… duende is real… flamenco knows
That's my boy
